arguments.e: using Test,SHA; tight_medium_work=Any[]; @testset "Medium tight actual work companion" begin; for native in (false,true), header_strategy in (:projected,:same_object_union); f=NPB.pb_native_fixture(;native,nobjects=32,steps=128); s=TightCallProgram.prepare_tight_calls(f.model;steps=0,outputs=:none,state_strategy=native ? :native : :references,header_strategy,count_calls=true); PlantSimEngine.continue!(s;steps=128); r=TightCallProgram.tight_call_report(s); d=bytes2hex(sha256(repr(CR.portable_downstream_snapshot(s)))); @test d==tight_medium_screen.expected_digest; @test r.executed_numerical_roots==4096; @test r.executed_numerical_calls==24576; @test r.typed_model_lookups==12288; @test r.fallback_batch_executions==0; @test (r.executed_native_column_fields>0)==native; push!(tight_medium_work,(;native,header_strategy,digest=d,report=r)); end; end; open(joinpath(pwd(),"benchmark/native_downstream/results/pure-gap/tight-medium-work.json"),"w") do io; PlantSimEngine.JSON.print(io,tight_medium_work,2); end; (passed=true,arms=length(tight_medium_work))
